property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that always accepts the forwarded transferFrom calls, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for the same successful executions and thus violates this rule.

For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that accepts the forwarded transferFrom calls, the reference contract's transfer(...) returns true on successful completion; the mutant returns false for the same successful executions, thus violating this rule.

For every call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array and a callee that successfully handles the forwarded transferFrom calls, the reference contract returns true (successful completion boolean), whereas the mutant returns false for the same successful executions.

For every call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array where the callee successfully accepts all forwarded transferFrom calls, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for such successful executions, so the boolean return value must be true for all admissible inputs.
Calling transfer forwards the given value to every address in the _tos array (i.e., number of successful external calls equals _tos.length).

For any non-empty _tos array, calling transfer reverts iff the call to caddress.transferFrom to the first recipient (index 0) fails — so the overall call always reverts when the first external transfer fails.
If any external transfer call to any recipient in the provided _tos array fails, the whole transfer call reverts (so reverted == true whenever any individual transferFrom to any _tos[i] would fail).
